# [TASK] Integrate automated Cloudflare tunnel into start-infrastructure.sh and stop-infrastructure.sh

## Task
Add a `--tunnel` / `--live` flag to `start-infrastructure.sh` that automatically spins up the Cloudflare Tunnel once services are healthy, and update `stop-infrastructure.sh` to cleanly tear down the tunnel alongside the main stack.

## Scope
Includes updates to `infrastructure/scripts/start-infrastructure.sh` and `infrastructure/scripts/stop-infrastructure.sh`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `start-infrastructure.sh --tunnel` launches the Cloudflare tunnel automatically and prints the public HTTPS URL.
- [x] `stop-infrastructure.sh` automatically detects and terminates running tunnel containers.
- [x] Preserves all existing local dev startup workflows when flag is omitted.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 2

## Notes
Verified: `start-infrastructure.sh` handles the tunnel flag.
